contact_text: Brand identities, campaigns, art direction or a marketing lead, part-time or remote. Tell me what you're building.
intro: I build brands from scratch. Specialised in marketing & communication. Berlin & London, working remotely.
about: I started my first company in my final year at university, aged 21, with friends I've known since I was 16. What began as German Kraft in London grew into breweries, bars, food halls and a distillery across the UK, Austria & Germany.

I've been involved in every department, but my home is brand and marketing. I create brands from scratch, position them in their market and make noise about them through campaigns, PR and events. Now I take on freelance and remote work for independent brands that care about honest materials and good people.
about_heading: Self-taught in business, trained in design, not afraid of the deep end.
